description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WPF application, with MVVM binding, Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Owned dialogs stay above normal and always-on-top hosts, including nested pickers and messages. Light and Dark themes cover toolbars, menus, source editing and dialogs, with improved high-contrast presentation. Native document scrollbars respect individual axes and survive a body-only Source round-trip without changing the document's rendering mode. Repeated Vertical assignments preserve body styles. Includes element-click events, safe Ctrl+Click web and mail links, and searching from dialogs opened by host code. Preview links open in the default browser on every click. Items in your own EditorContextMenuStrip that use ApplicationCommands act on the editor. Opened documents keep their relative stylesheets and the editor's own head, and Content.OpenFile works. Rebinding or disabling an action also stops its built-in shortcut.
title: SpiceLogic WPF HTML Editor Control
